name: Czech Republic

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024: land area 77,156 km2 (AG.LND.TOTL.K2). Low/high allow for the Natural Earth polygon vs official figure and inland water (surface area is a few % larger).

population.note: asOf 2025: World Bank SP.POP.TOTL 10,886,878. Range allows for 2026 drift and census revisions.

activePersonnel.note: IISS as quoted: 26,600 active. CIA Factbook 2025 ~28,000 (high).

trainedReserves.note: Educated guess. IISS as quoted lists no reserves; the Czech Active Reserve has a few thousand members in regional units.

supportPersonnel.note: Active 26,600 minus infantry P roles (4,500). Covers navy and air force personnel, armour/artillery/air-defence crews, logistics, staff, training and other support.

mobilizationRatio.note: Analogy to Czechoslovakia 1938 (~1.25 million mobilized from ~15 million, ~8%) at the high end; low for today's all-volunteer force with no conscription since 2005.

weapons.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: Spike, SPYDER, CAESAR.

cyber.note: Between anchor 9 and 10: National Cyber and Information Security Agency, cyber forces.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 429,581,362,068 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD x 0.8005) / population 10,886,878 = 39,459. Range +/-10%.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 536,641,301,772 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 429,581,362,068 2011 int$. Range +/-10% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank MS.MIL.XPND.GD.ZS: 1.84% of GDP in 2025 (mid), 1.88% in 2024, 1.35% in 2021. Low is the lowest of those years; high allows ~5% for NATO-definition spending above SIPRI.

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction 28.7% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-1.5 pp for year-to-year variation.

foodSurplus.note: Educated guess. Near self-sufficient in cereals, imports fruit/vegetables.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 5,369,227 (SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN) x share of males aged 15-19 5.732% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 61,549. Males only (conscript-pool convention); about double if women are counted. Range +/-10%.

artillery.note: Educated guess. Excalibur Army DANA M2 and Morana; CSG ammunition. (context page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_military_equipment_of_the_Czech_Army)

ifv_apc.note: Educated guess. Tatra/Excalibur Army Pandur, Titus and T-72 overhaul.

railKm.note: asOf 2021: 9,357 route-km (IS.RRS.TOTL.KM). Low allows for closures since.

merchantTonnage.note: Landlocked; CIA Factbook lists no Czech-flag merchant marine.

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. By analogy to NATO mechanized brigade sustainment (truck-based, depots every ~150-200 km).

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Horses, mules and donkeys, not from FAO data. Militarily irrelevant in 2026.

nuclearWarheads.note: Non-nuclear-weapon state (NPT); FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 lists only nine nuclear-armed states. FAS lists the five US B61 host states (Belgium, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Turkey); this state is not one of them.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.2: mountain-ringed Bohemia, fortified cities, population support.

notes: Modern snapshot, asOf 2025 World Bank data with an Oct 2026 order of battle. Population convention: everything inside ne:CZE. Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Force counts from the Wikipedia Czech Army equipment list, Czech Land Forces article (equipment as of 1 Jan 2023) and active Czech military aircraft list; drones = Group 2+ only. Infantry P-role splits, L-159 and helicopter counts are educated guesses (grade D). Landlocked: ships tech describes river craft only.
